_comment: REL-03 (issue #447): the machine-readable release-gate registry. Human view + rationale: docs/development/release-gates.md. Validated by `go run ./cmd/releasegatecheck` (every `workflow` exists; the doc table matches this file). The `release-gate` job in docker-publish.yml reads `release_gate:true` gates and blocks publication if any is observed FAILED on the release commit. Do not hand-edit this or the doc table without the other.

tiers.per-pr: Fast enough to run on every pull request; blocks merge via the main-protection ruleset and is re-checked on the release commit by the release-gate job.
tiers.release-internal: A job inside docker-publish.yml; enforced by that workflow's needs: graph, so the release cannot publish if it fails.
tiers.release-tier: Too slow for every PR (nightly / push:main / on-dispatch). The #499 release workflow will trigger and wait for these; until then the ones that run on the release commit's push:main cover it.
tiers.advisory: Runs and is visible, but a failure does not block a release. A regression is triaged, not gating.

gates.name: Backend (Go)
gates.criterion: go build + go vet + gofmt clean and `go test ./... -race` passes; no package exceeds its -timeout.

gates.name: Frontend (Vitest)
gates.criterion: `tsc --noEmit` and `vitest run` both pass.

gates.name: Run E2E Tests
gates.criterion: the route-stubbed Playwright suite (including @perf specs) passes.

gates.name: Android (Gradle)
gates.criterion: `testDebugUnitTest`, `lintDebug`, `detekt`, and `assembleDebug` all pass.

gates.name: Android E2E (emulator)
gates.criterion: the instrumented suite passes against the docker-compose.test.yml backend on an API-26 emulator.

gates.name: Android scan (mobsfscan)
gates.criterion: mobsfscan reports no new high-severity finding on the Android sources.

gates.name: Scan workflows (zizmor)
gates.criterion: zizmor exits 0 — no finding above what zizmor.yml's ignore list accepts.

gates.name: CIS container hardening scan
gates.criterion: the all-in-one image passes docker/cis-hardening.sh and the Trivy misconfig/secret scan with no CRITICAL/HIGH.

gates.name: codecov/patch/backend
gates.criterion: changed Go lines are >= 95% covered (codecov.yml). Merge-time only: a PR-diff concept, not re-polled at publication.

gates.name: codecov/patch/frontend
gates.criterion: changed TypeScript lines are >= 90% covered. Merge-time only.

gates.name: codecov/patch/android
gates.criterion: changed Kotlin lines are >= 80% covered. Merge-time only.

gates.name: Detect Changes
gates.criterion: the shared path-filter job completes; always green (structural). Required so path-skipped suites can be required checks (#264).

gates.name: Docs & security-doc citations
gates.criterion: citecheck + depexceptions + deprecations + docscheck + releasegatecheck all exit 0. Runs on every PR and nightly; not yet in the main-protection ruleset (candidate for #508).

gates.name: Migration Tests
gates.criterion: every supported-release upgrade leg, adjacent hop, and down round-trip passes. Per-leg check names make polling impractical; the release commit only adds a frozen schema dump, which schema-fixture-gate verifies, and the push:main run covers the chain.

gates.name: Go binary reproducible
gates.criterion: two builds from different paths are byte-identical (REL-04). Runs on the release commit's push:main; not in the ruleset.

gates.name: validate-tag
gates.criterion: the pushed tag matches the versioning-policy pattern (REL-01, backend/internal/versionpolicy). Blocks every downstream job.

gates.name: release-gate
gates.criterion: no mandatory release_gate:true gate is observed FAILED on the release commit; all-green passes; a 60-minute deadline with a gate still not reporting is a warning and publication proceeds (the deterministic trigger-and-wait is #499). A workflow_dispatch run with a non-empty override_reason skips the poll and records the override with the actor.

gates.name: schema-fixture-gate
gates.criterion: a committed backend/database/testdata/schemas/<tag>.sql exists for a mycorrhizal-supported-series tag (MIG-01, #436/#529).

gates.name: build-and-push
gates.criterion: the multi-arch images build and push; each digest gets a cosign keyless signature, an SBOM, and SLSA build provenance.

gates.name: build-android-apk
gates.criterion: the release APK assembles, is keystore-signed, `apksigner verify` passes (and matches ANDROID_SIGNING_CERT_SHA256 when set), its versionCode equals the computed value and is > 1, and provenance + a cosign bundle are produced and attached to the Release.

gates.name: verify-release-assets
gates.criterion: the GitHub Release carries app-release.apk and mycorrhizal-apk.sigstore.json, and every published image tag resolves in the registry.

gates.name: Test minimum supported versions
gates.criterion: the app builds and the suite passes against each declared minimum runtime (COMPAT-02, #473).

gates.name: Migration at scale (large dataset)
gates.criterion: with MYCORRHIZAL_LARGE_TESTS=1, every supported release migrates to current at ~134x the canonical manifest with row counts and integrity intact (#495).

gates.name: CardDAV real-server E2E
gates.criterion: a full round trip against the real reference servers matches the divergence register (#496).

gates.name: Constrained-resource chaos
gates.criterion: the disk-full / mem-limited / cpu-limited jobs fail closed with no corruption (#498).

gates.name: Schemathesis API fuzzing
gates.criterion: no unhandled 500, no response that violates backend/openapi.yaml, no BOLA finding.

gates.name: Differential E2E (calcard)
gates.criterion: our JSContact / iCalendar output matches the pinned reference implementations (#680).

gates.name: Reference-clients E2E
gates.criterion: vdirsyncer round-trips against our server with no data loss (#681).

gates.name: ZAP DAST
gates.criterion: the baseline scan raises no new high-risk dynamic finding.

gates.name: OpenSSF Scorecard
gates.criterion: informational supply-chain posture; a score drop is reviewed, never release-blocking.

gates.name: CodeQL
gates.criterion: SARIF is uploaded; a new alert is triaged in the Security tab, not release-blocking.

gates.name: Grype vulnerability scan
gates.criterion: second-opinion CVE scan; the critical/high hard gate is on main + nightly, advisory at release time.

gates.name: TruffleHog secret scan
gates.criterion: verified-secret git-history scan; a hit is investigated immediately but is not a release job.

gates.name: Stryker mutation testing
gates.criterion: mutation-score trend for the core modules; advisory.

gates.name: Android macrobenchmark
gates.criterion: cold/warm/hot startup and dashboard frame timing trend; continue-on-error by design (emulator variance).

gates.name: Reproducible image (all-in-one)
gates.criterion: double-build config + layer digest compare for the linux/amd64 image; continue-on-error until reliably green on main (REL-04, #448).
